concepts.title: A room becomes a Spec
concepts.question: Keep this wall with the vanity decision.
concepts.detail: The source stays with the Spec. No dimensions inferred.
ux: Expand the photo receipt inline, then attach it to the conversation’s Spec.
Drag the room photograph onto a Vanity Spec node; a source link remains.
Choose the photo, select Vanity as its destination, then confirm the attachment.
Select the Vanity row and add the photo in its source inspector.
Lift the site-photo page to reveal a Spec tab, then pin the photo to it.

concepts.title: The next useful question
concepts.question: What should we resolve before booking delivery?
concepts.detail: A useful next action clears a dependency; no supplier answer is invented.
ux: Select an inline next-action suggestion and reveal why it is blocking delivery.
Connect the delivery task to the access photo to expose the missing dimension.
Eliminate non-blocking choices, then choose the access check.
Filter the register to blockers and open the delivery-access task.
Swipe to the entry page and pull up its unresolved delivery question.

concepts.title: Recall the decision
concepts.question: Why did we choose the blue-green tile?

rows.label: Reason
rows.value: Worked with the room in daylight

concepts.detail: Recall preserves who chose it and why, not an entire chat replay.
ux: Open a cited material decision directly from the assistant’s answer.
Follow the tile-to-approval connection on the evidence board.
Narrow room, material, then decision to recover the reason.
Filter approved materials and inspect the tile’s decision history.
Swipe the material index to the sample page, then turn up the approval note.

concepts.title: Keep the walkthrough in context
concepts.question: What does Dev need to check around the vanity?
concepts.detail: The video locates the question. Dev still needs to measure on site.
ux: Collapse the playing video into a compact citation inside the reply.
Drag the video tile beside the installer-question node.
Review the footage, choose the question, then retain the reference.
Open the walkthrough from an evidence cell while the inspector stays available.
Scrub the site video, then pull a question sheet up over the preserved media.

concepts.title: Layout changes the order
concepts.question: What changes if we choose herringbone?
concepts.source: Maya · user-entered area · verify on site
concepts.detail: Herringbone includes a separate +1 box layout allowance after waste rounding.
ux: Toggle layout within the answer and reveal the arithmetic receipt.
Swap the layout card attached to the quantity node; total updates in place.
Choose a layout, inspect waste and extra-box allowance, then confirm.
Edit the layout cell and review a seven-to-eight-box change in the inspector.
Swipe between layout sketches and pull up the order calculation.

concepts.title: Judge the sample in daylight
concepts.question: Does this finish work in the bathroom light?
concepts.detail: A finish approval is not a slip-rating or installation approval.
ux: Play the sample in the conversation, expand room context, then approve finish.
Place sample and room images beside each other and connect the chosen finish.
Inspect light, compare room context, then make the finish decision.
Compare the sample’s evidence in an inspector and update finish status.
Swipe between sample video and room photo, then mark the daylight note approved.

concepts.title: Installer words become a field
concepts.question: Save Dev’s start date without losing the condition.
concepts.result: Start window saved with its condition
concepts.detail: “We can start the week of October 12, once the vanity is on site.”
ux: Select the transcript phrase and accept an inline structured-field suggestion.
Drag the highlighted quote into a start-window node; keep the source line.
Review the extracted date, retain the dependency, then save both.
Select transcript text in the inspector and apply the conditional date to the row.
Highlight Dev’s words on a notebook page and pin a dated field beneath them.

concepts.title: Confirm—not guess—the clearance
concepts.question: Which entry dimension has actually been measured?
concepts.detail: The photograph locates the note. It does not generate a measurement.
ux: Open a measurement citation and separate confirmed from unknown dimensions.
Select the door hotspot to reveal its linked measurement note.
Identify the door, inspect Dev’s source, then leave the landing unresolved.
Inspect measurement provenance while the unconfirmed cell remains empty.
Tap the doorway annotation and pull up Dev’s measured note over the photo.

concepts.title: See the schedule risk
concepts.question: Will this pendant arrive before the plumber?
concepts.source: Demo lead time · confirm with supplier
concepts.detail: A schedule comparison, not a supplier delivery guarantee.
ux: Expand the lead-time phrase into an inline date comparison.
Drag the arrival marker against the fixed plumber milestone.
Set order date, compare the booked visit, then review the 28-day conflict.
Switch the order row to timeline view and inspect the late-arrival delta.
Scrub a dated project strip to place the arrival after the plumber visit.

concepts.title: Compare with an honest unknown
concepts.question: Does the brass alternative meet the Spec?
concepts.result: Supplier question prepared · no reply yet
concepts.detail: Keep the missing value blank. Do not claim the alternative meets 2700 K.
ux: Reveal a compact comparison under the answer and turn the empty field into a question.
Link matching attributes but leave the colour-temperature connection visibly open.
Pass the known matches, pause at the unknown, and prepare the supplier question.
Compare specified and alternative columns; open the empty cell’s question action.
Flip the pendant reference to its comparison note and flag the empty temperature field.

concepts.title: Two kinds of approval
concepts.question: Who still needs to approve this change?
concepts.detail: Two separate responsibilities. This is not checkout or a charge.
ux: Open Dev’s fit receipt, then request and confirm Sam’s separate budget approval.
Connect two role-specific approval nodes to the same change.
Review installation first, then confirm the budget responsibility in a second step.
Resolve Dev and Sam in separate owner columns with a visible audit trail.
Turn between Dev’s site check and Sam’s budget note; keep both signatures.

concepts.title: The last four steps
concepts.question: What should the delivery team know about this entry?
concepts.detail: The photo and manual note stay with delivery instructions.
ux: Attach the entry photo and write the access note within the order conversation.
Drag the access photo and four-step note onto the delivery task.
Inspect the entry, enter the manual note, then attach it to delivery.
Edit the delivery-access cell and pin its supporting photo in the inspector.
Annotate the visible steps on the entry page and fold the note into delivery.

concepts.title: Handoff with the evidence
concepts.question: Prepare Dev’s pack without hiding unresolved details.
concepts.detail: Only confirmed Specs are included; unresolved mirror width is called out.
ux: Choose the confirmed Specs in chat and expand a cited pack preview.
Gather confirmed Spec nodes into a pack, leaving an unresolved note visible.
Select confirmed items, review the unresolved note, then prepare the draft.
Bulk-select confirmed rows and inspect the generated handoff document.
Bookmark confirmed pages into a pack and turn to the draft cover.

concepts.title: Keep evidence after the order
concepts.question: What evidence do we need before asking for a return?
concepts.source: Order receipt · supplier terms not confirmed
concepts.result: Return question prepared · refund not issued
concepts.detail: Receipt capture does not establish eligibility or trigger a refund.
ux: Open the receipt citation and prepare the return question in the order thread.
Connect the receipt to the order while the return-condition node stays unresolved.
Attach proof, check the missing policy, then prepare—not submit—a return request.
Attach the receipt to the order row and inspect unresolved return requirements.
File the receipt behind the pendant page and flag the return-policy question.
